english.text: The American Congress of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, in an opinion from its Committee on Obstetric Practice that was published on the ACOG website, said that instead of quickly clamping off the cord that connects the newborn to its placental sac, doctors should wait an additional 30 to 60 seconds. Those extra seconds for babies born at term are associated with an increase in hemoglobin levels in newborns, the statement said.

text: 美國婦產科醫生大會喺佢嘅產科實務委員會喺 ACOG 網站上發表嘅意見中指出，醫生唔應該快速夾住連接新生兒同胎盤囊嘅繩，而係應該額外等30個時間 60秒。 聲明指出，足月出世嘅嬰兒額外嘅秒數同新生兒嘅血紅蛋白水平增加有關。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the night of the 9th of November of 2021, as I entered the cafe to get my iced green tea, a hunky man sat at a table, as he fiddled with his laptop. As I sat at a table by the window, Michael the Guǎngzhōu Man entered and ordered his coffee. We sat together talking. He said that he was flying off tomorrow to visit China for six months. We talked about Thailand, a favourite topic. The food is excellent there. Thai and Vietnamese women have nice personalities, I emphasized. On parting, he gave me a cup of instant noodles. On my way home, I saw Rod my white neighbour. He said that he just retired from his water recycling job. He needs a hobby, we both agreed. I emphasized that the Web has many hobby opportunities.

text: 喺2021年11月9號嘅夜晚，當我進入咖啡館攞我嘅冰綠茶嗰陣，有個大隻佬坐喺一張枱度，佢玩緊佢部手提電腦。當我坐喺窗邊張檯度嗰陣，古宗人米高入嚟叫咗佢杯咖啡。我哋坐埋一齊傾偈。佢話佢聽日會飛去中國探訪半年。我哋講咗泰國，呢個係我最鍾意嘅話題。嗰度嘅食物好正。我強調，泰國同越南女人嘅性格都好好。分手嗰陣，佢畀咗杯即食麵我。返屋企途中，我見到我個白人鄰居 Rod 。佢話佢啱啱喺佢嘅水回收工作度退休。佢需要一個嗜好，我哋兩個都同意。我強調過，網絡有好多嗜好嘅機會。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Last night, I ate jackfruit in yellow-white coconut milk with rice for dinner. After 7 in the morning, today the 26th of November of 2024, I ate a corn dog and drank a mug of hot lemon water. Before 8, I walked around and around the neighbourhood cul-de-sac. It was a grey sky. There is a house there with a front door decorated with gold-on-red "lucky" logograms. There are still pumpkins, a gigantic one and a mini one, in the front yard. A castle-like house stands in the corner. When I returned home, I opened my delivered parcel of a grey-green stone Godzilla. How wonderful it looks! On my mind now, Latinate artificial languages may have advantages over those that are not Latinate. I am thinking of Esperanto and Interlingua. Even natural languages like Tagalog and Japanese are full of international Latinate terms. (In Japanese, they are written in Katakana glyphs. It is fun to read a Japanese menu full of French and Italian food names written in Katakana. And I find it easier to read Japanese books in the sci-fi genre, because they are full of Katakana words derived from English and other languages. (Japanese is a cosmopolitan language.)) I am also thinking that a Latinate language with a blend of the indigenous may be fun and fascinating, as in the case of Philippine Creole Spanish (Chavacano (Chabacano)).

jyutping: cam4 maan5，ngo5 sik6 zo2 wong4 baak6 je4 naai5 ge3 ngau4 jau4 gwo2 pui3 faan6 zou6 maan5 caan1。ziu1 zou2 cat1 dim2 zi1 hau6，gam1 jat6 2024 nin4 11 jyut6 26 hou6，ngo5 sik6 zo2 zek3 suk1 mai5 gau2，jam2 zo2 bui1 jit6 ning4 mung1 seoi2。dim2 cin4，ngo5 hai6 leon4 gan6 ge3 sei2 lou6 jat1 tiu4 haang4 zo2 jat1 hyun1，haang4 zo2 jat1 hyun1。go2 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 fui1 sik1 ge3 tin1 hung1。go2 dou6 jau5 gaan1 uk1，cin4 mun2 soeng6 min6 zong1 sik1 zyu6 gam1 sik1 ge3 hung4 sik1「hang6 wan6」biu1 zi3。cin4 jyun2 zung6 jau5 di1 naam4 gwaa1，jat1 go3 geoi6 jing4 ge3 tung4 jat1 go3 mai4 nei5 ge3。hai2 gok3 lok6 dou6 kei5 zo2 jat1 gaan1 hou2 ci5 sing4 bou2 gam2 ge3 uk1。dong1 ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6，ngo5 daa2 hoi1 zo2 ngo5 sung3 dou3 lai4 ge3 baau1 gwo2，jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 zek3 fui1 luk6 sik1 ge3 sek6 go1 si1 laai1。tai2 lok6 hou2 zing1 coi2！ngo5 ji4 gaa1 nam2，laai1 ding1 man2 jan4 gung1 jyu5 jin4 ho2 nang4 bei2 hei2 m4 hai6 laai1 ding1 man2 ge3 jyu5 jin4 jau5 jau1 sai3。ngo5 nam2 gan2 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 tung4 gwok3 zai3 jyu5 jin4。zau6 syun3 hai6 taap3 gaa1 lok3 man4 tung4 jat6 man2 ni1 di1 zi6 jin4 jyu5 jin4，dou1 cung1 mun5 zo2 gwok3 zai3 laai1 ding1 man2 ge3 seot6 jyu5。 （hai2 jat6 man2 jap6 min6，keoi5 dei6 hai6 jung6 pin3 gaa2 ming4 zi6 jing4 se2 ge3。tai2 jat1 go3 jat6 man2 caan1 paai2 soeng6 min6 se2 zyu6 jung6 pin3 gaa2 ming4 se2 ge3 faat3 man2 tung4 ji3 daai6 lei6 sik6 mat6 meng2，zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 waan2。ji4 ngo5 gok3 dak1 tai2 fo1 waan6 leoi6 jing4 ge3 jat6 man2 syu1 bei2 gaau3 jung4 ji6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 jap6 min6 cung1 mun5 zo2 jyun4 zi6 jing1 man2 tung4 kei4 taa1 jyu5 jin4 ge3 pin3 gaa2 ming4 zi6。（jat6 man2 hai6 jat1 zung2 sai3 gaai3 sing3 ge3 jyu5 jin4。））ngo5 jik6 dou1 gok3 dak1 laai1 ding1 man2 ge3 jyu5 jin4 ho2 nang4 hai6 wan6 hap6 sik1 ge3 fei1 leot6 ban1 hak1 lei5 ou3 ji5 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 man2（caa4 ngaa5 kaa1 nok6（Chabacano））。
text: 尋晚，我食咗黃白椰奶嘅牛油果配飯做晚餐。朝早七點之後，今日2024年11月26號，我食咗隻粟米狗，飲咗杯熱檸檬水。點前，我係鄰近嘅死路一條行咗一圈，行咗一圈。嗰個係一個灰色嘅天空。嗰度有間屋，前門上面裝飾住金色嘅紅色「幸運」標誌。前院仲有啲南瓜，一個巨型嘅同一個迷你嘅。喺角落度企咗一間好似城堡噉嘅屋。當我返到屋企嗰陣，我打開咗我送到嚟嘅包裹，入面有一隻灰綠色嘅石哥斯拉。睇落好精彩！我而家諗，拉丁文人工語言可能比起唔係拉丁文嘅語言有優勢。我諗緊世界語同國際語言。就算係塔加洛文同日文呢啲自然語言，都充滿咗國際拉丁文嘅術語。 （喺日文入面，佢哋係用片假名字形寫嘅。睇一個日文餐牌上面寫住用片假名寫嘅法文同意大利食物名，真係好好玩。而我覺得睇科幻類型嘅日文書比較容易，因為佢哋入面充滿咗源自英文同其他語言嘅片假名字。（日文係一種世界性嘅語言。））我亦都覺得拉丁文嘅語言可能係混合式嘅菲律賓克里奧爾西班牙文（查瓦卡諾（Chabacano））。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: If our democracy is to work in this increasingly diverse nation, then each one of us need to try to heed the advice of a great character in American fiction — Atticus Finch — who said: "You never really understand a person until you consider things from his point of view…until you climb into his skin and walk around in it."

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 man4 zyu2 jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 jat6 jik1 do1 jyun4 faa3 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 wan6 zok3，gam2 ngo5 dei6 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 soeng4 si3 teng1 cung4 mei5 gwok3 siu2 syut3 zung1 jat1 go3 wai5 daai6 jan4 mat2 — aa3 tai4 hak1 si1 · fan1 kei4 — ge3 gin3 ji5，keoi5 waa6：「nei5 wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 zan1 zing3 lei5 gaai2 jat1 go3 jan4，ceoi4 fei1 nei5 cung4 keoi5 ge3 gok3 dou6 heoi3 haau2 leoi6 si6 cing4 ...... zik6 dou3 nei5 paa4 jap6 keoi5 ge3 pei4 fu1 jap6 min6，jin4 hau6 hai2 keoi5 ge3 pei4 fu1 jap6 min6 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3。」
text: 如果我哋嘅民主要喺呢個日益多元化嘅國家運作，噉我哋每個人都需要嘗試聽從美國小說中一個偉大人物 — 阿提克斯 · 芬奇 — 嘅建議，佢話：「你永遠唔會真正理解一個人，除非你從佢嘅角度去考慮事情 ...... 直到你爬入佢嘅皮膚入面，然後喺佢嘅皮膚入面行嚟行去。」
